reading.body:
This facility does not qualify as a commercial data center. OpenStreetMap marks a location in Lufkin, Angelina County, Texas, as "Precision Prints Lufkin Datacenter," but the name identifies a printing business with what appears to be an in-house server room supporting its own operations, not a facility leasing capacity to outside customers. No published specifications, power rating, or operator contact information could be confirmed despite exhaustive research.

Texas has 133 mapped data-center locations, of which 18 publish power capacity totaling 468 MW. This facility publishes no power figure and ranks outside the published capacity list.

This location does not factor into assessments of commercial AI infrastructure capacity.
